name: VR Piano Light
summary:
Turn your Meta Quest into an immersive musical instrument and creative studio.

VR Piano Lights lets you play piano and drums in virtual reality, experiment with sounds, mix audio with an interactive console, and create your own musical loops in an environment designed for music lovers.

## Features

🎹 Interactive VR piano  
🥁 Interactive VR drums  
🎚️ Interactive mixer and effects console  
🎵 Record and play back musical loops
